verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents role-based access: viewer, contributor, editor and owner roles control reading, adding, editing, deleting and moving pages. Server-passed scopes decide which pages a run can read, search is filtered to readable pages, and permissions can be set at individual, team and org level. Nothing in the pack shows any audit trail or access logging, which is half the story. Missing for 10: audit logging of read/write access, explicit policy/ACL configuration docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can govern who and what can read or write memory with roles, policies, or access-control lists, and audit that access

citations.quote: a viewer reads, a contributor adds pages and notes, an editor changes pages, and an owner can also delete pages and move them between scopes.
the scopes your server passes for a run decide which ones it can read.
Search only returns pages the run can read
set permissions at the individual, team and org level.
